ns2:section.sectionText: Can NOT use this CRN (10538) to enroll in the course. Masters students: CRN for instructor will be provided to the student AFTER the required paperwork has been completed, signatures secured, and returned as instructed. For 599 form, go to http://www.lis.uiuc.edu/courses/pdfs/599form.pdf. PhD students: inform the office staff of the faculty advisor you are registering with and the CRN for the faculty instructor will be provided.
